title: Clinical and radiographic outcomes of non -surgical retreatment of mature maxillary incisors using two regenerative endodontic techniques in adolescents: a 24-month randomized clinical trial Elheeny A A H, EL Bahnasy S S, ElMakawi Y M
authors: Turky M, Ahmed E F, Wahba N K O. BDJ Open 2025 Apr 11. 11(36).
supports: Clinical study from the botiss collacone / collafleece (collagen cone and fleece) literature list — the product featured in it, which is not the same as the study being about the product, so check the design and the comparator before citing it as product evidence. Authors' conclusion, verbatim: “REPs were effective in the retreatment of mature maxillary permanent incisors with apical periodontitis with a comparable reduction in the periapical radiolucencies and clinical outcomes associated with approximately similar positive responses to thermal a nd electric pulp tests” This records what the paper says, not what a rep may say: the sales wording still has to pass the claim tiers, and a study in one indication licenses nothing in another.
